as_told.title: Sherman's unnamed base identified as San Vito in southern Italy
as_told.place_text: San Vito dei Normanni, southern Italy; Nebraska

plain: Michels says that he and his researcher took a photo of a base printed in Above Black, a book by a former sergeant named Dan Sherman, ran a reverse image search on it, which matches a picture against others online, and found it was San Vito dei Normanni in southern Italy. Michels tells it on the show as his own find, and Sherman, sitting with him, confirms it was one of the bases where he was stationed in the 1990s, which would place his story at a real site.
